customApp.title: Add Custom App
customApp.name: Name
customApp.allowPrivilegedHelp: Disables security checks and lets this app use host networking, cap_add, privileged mode, and device access. A malicious image can compromise the host. Only enable for apps you fully trust.
customApp.portHelp: The port the app listens on inside its container. Tomo serves the app through its own login proxy on a different port.
customApp.composeYamlHelp: Paste the app's compose file. Tomo reads the port from it and removes any host mapping for that port, so the app is only reachable through Tomo.
customApp.openPathHelp: Where the app's web page lives if it is not at "/", for example "/ui" or "/login". Only the link on the desktop changes.
customApp.ownAuth: This app has its own sign-in
customApp.ownAuthHelp: Serve it without the Tomo login so tools outside the browser can reach it, for example an API. Only for apps that require their own password or API key.
customApp.willUnpublish: Port {{port}} detected from the YAML. The "{{mapping}}" mapping will be removed so the app is only reachable through Tomo.
customApp.yamlProblem: This YAML cannot be used yet: {{error}}
customApp.redeployNote: Changing the image, port, YAML, or privileged setting restarts the app with the new settings. Its data is kept.

phase.installing: Downloading images and creating containers. Large apps can take a few minutes.
phase.starting: Containers are up. Waiting for the app to respond...

tokens.intro: Tokens let agents such as Claude Code, and your own scripts, use Tomo without a browser. Each token has a scope and can be rotated or revoked at any time. Tokens are accepted from your local network only.
tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.name: Name

scopeHelp.manage: Read everything, start, stop, restart, update, install apps, and add or edit custom apps.
scopeHelp.admin: Everything in Manage, plus remove apps, change app stores, and turn on privileged mode or own sign-in.

tokens.neverWarning: A token that never expires stays valid until you revoke it. Prefer an expiry and rotate.
tokens.showOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.plainHttpWarning: Tomo serves plain HTTP on your network, so this token travels unencrypted. Use it on your own network only.
tokens.rotateWarning: A new secret is issued and shown once. The old secret keeps working for 15 minutes, then stops.
tokens.revokeWarning: Anything using this token stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
